gloss: full dose; full capacity; maximum amount

definitions.gloss: full dose; full capacity; maximum amount
definitions.explanation: The maximum quantity or dose of something, particularly medication, fuel, or any substance measured by volume or weight. Commonly used in pharmaceutical and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}は{満量|まんりょう}まで{増|ふ}やした。
examples.english: The medication was increased to the full dose.

examples.japanese: タンクに{満量|まんりょう}の{燃料|ねんりょう}を{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please fill the tank to full capacity with fuel.

examples.japanese: {一日|いちにち}の{満量|まんりょう}を{超|こ}えて{服用|ふくよう}すると{副作用|ふくさよう}のリスクが{高|たか}まる。
examples.english: Taking more than the maximum daily dose increases the risk of side effects.

notes:
Composed of {満|まん} (full, filled) and {量|りょう} (quantity, amount). Most commonly encountered in pharmaceutical contexts where dosage limits are specified, but also used for fuel tanks, containers, and other measurable quantities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満量|まんりょう}{処方|しょほう}: full-dose prescription
- {一日|いちにち}{満量|まんりょう}: maximum daily dose
- {満量|まんりょう}まで{増|ふ}やす: to increase to the full dose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最大量|さいだいりょう}: maximum amount — more general and less technical
- {上限量|じょうげんりょう}: upper limit amount — emphasizes the ceiling rather than the full amount
- {適量|てきりょう}: appropriate amount — the right amount, not necessarily the maximum

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with {満了|まんりょう} (expiration, completion of a term), which shares the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
